halves the bucket aggregation. What it also saves, and the hypothesis leaves
out, is half the window-combination doublings, so (for positive b, c, N, D,
C) the break-even strictly exceeds the model's aggregation-only saving
(b/(2c)) 2^c R/N. In the model: GLV wins iff
C_alpha < (b/(2c)) (2^c R + c D + C)/N.
